The Pelican Platform mark in this directory
===========================================

File
    PelicanPlatformLogo_Icon.png
    51,041 bytes
    sha256 21427ef3cac9eb02d0ed4b678686e4259df6187d074f0457f07481332fbc413d

Provenance
    Copied byte-for-byte from the Pelican Platform source tree,
    web_ui/frontend/public/static/images/PelicanPlatformLogo_Icon.png, where
    it is imported by components/layout/Header.tsx and three navigation
    components. It is the same icon the project's public branding page
    offers. No SVG form of the mark exists anywhere in that tree, so this
    PNG is the mark's only available form; it has NOT been traced, redrawn
    or otherwise altered here, and no derivative of the bird appears
    anywhere in this repository.

Permission
    Used with the permission of the Pelican Project's Principal
    Investigator. That permission is what Apache-2.0 leaves to be obtained:
    section 6 of the licence grants no trademark rights ("This License does
    not grant permission to use the trade names, trademarks, service marks,
    or product names of the Licensor..."), so the grant is recorded here,
    next to the asset, rather than reasoned about later.

What this is NOT
    pelfs is an independent tool for Pelican federations. It is NOT an
    official Pelican Platform product, and the permission to use the mark
    does not make it one. Every page of the UI carries that sentence in its
    footer (src/brand/Brand.tsx, BrandFooter), and the repository carries it
    in NOTICE at the root.

Palette
    The three brand colours used by this UI come from the Pelican source of
    truth, web_ui/frontend/components/ThemeProvider.tsx:34-39 --
    primary #0885ff, primary.light #CFE4FF, secondary #FFFFFA -- and are
    defined once, in src/brand/brand.css. The two durability colours (amber
    for "on this machine only", green for "in the federation") are pelfs's
    own and are deliberately not brand blue.
